summary: Add bounded local JSON export and deterministic cross-run comparison for saved Reference QA results, citations and review history.
decision_refs: Active goal: CRIP manages local task, version, result, citation and review state
Comparison reports stored outcome differences without claiming engineering precedence
Export and comparison are read-only and make no model request
approval_evidence: The user instructed continued implementation of CRIP as the local management layer around an advanced-model reference analyst.
known_limitations: Comparison reports saved public output differences and does not decide which answer is correct or controlling.
Reference export is JSON only; spreadsheet export remains future work.
The fixed 15-question live advanced-model quality benchmark has not been rerun.
